title: Set up your voicemail greeting
blurb: Upload the greeting callers hear when nobody picks up.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click **Settings** at the bottom of the left menu.

steps.title: Open Phone System
steps.body: Click **Phone System** in the Settings menu.

steps.title: Find voicemail settings
steps.body: Open the voice settings and find **Voicemail & Missed Call Text Back**.
steps.tip: See **Your phone system requires configuration**? We need to switch Luubu Phone on for you. Email hello@luubu.com.

steps.title: Record your greeting
steps.body: Record a short greeting on your phone and save it as an MP3 or WAV. Say your business name and when you will call back.

steps.title: Staff greetings
steps.body: Staff can have their own greeting too. See **Set a team member's call and voicemail settings**.

steps.title: Test it
steps.body: Call your number and let it ring out to hear the greeting.
